text_block_list.text: —The day of the Kikuka Sho.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
—Whoa, so bright...
What a gorgeous blue sky.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
"What a lovely morning~ It's as if the sky itself
is foretelling Seiun Sky's victory."

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
"Oh?
What's wrong, Trainer-san?"

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
"You look like a Trainer whose Umamusume wouldn't wake up at all,
forcing you to scream her name outside her hotel door over and over."

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Nyahaha, sorry, sorry!
Though thanks to you, I'm feeling tip-top!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Having you pick me up is part of Sei-chan's pre-race routine, after all☆

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Alright, shall we head out~?
To Kyoto Racecourse!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
The Derby was so thrilling!
Special Week's fighting spirit was the real deal!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Seiun Sky is a formidable opponent, but the Kikuka-sho is a race won by the strongest horse girl.
Do your best, Spe...!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Wah-wah...!
Thank you so much for cheering for me, everyone!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
I'm—I'm going to win!
Because I want to live up to everyone's expectations!
(Waaaaaaah...!)

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, "the star of the show has arrived!"
That's the vibe. As expected of Spe-chan.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
King?
Your face looks stiff, you know?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
...!
Well, of course it'd stiffen up.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
"The final crown... No matter what it takes,
I have to claim it...!"

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
...Oh dear. She's brooding quite a bit.
Well, if it's her—

text_block_list.name: Spectator C
text_block_list.text: Seiun Sky~! Good luck~!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Oh my? Are you a fan of mine?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Man, you really shouldn't, you know?
I deee-finitely recommend Spe-chan instead.
Why not switch over now? Come on, pretty please?

text_block_list.name: Spectator C
text_block_list.text: Huh? U-Um, excuse me...

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
"Because the Kikuka Sho is a difficult race.
That's why they say the strongest Umamusume wins it."

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
"Then the obvious choice is Spe-chan!
...Don't you think so?"

text_block_list.name: Spectator C
text_block_list.text: That's... certainly true...

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
"...Fufu♪ I know, right~? So for now,
keep your eyes on Spe-chan. If you do—"

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
I'm going to betray you
so, so delightfully♪

text_block_list.name: Spectator C
text_block_list.text:
...!
Y-Yikes, y-yes!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Now then—
Everything is set and prepared to perfection. All that's left is to run.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: The Kikuka-sho... is mine for the taking.
